decisions.reason: As a niche men’s line with a trend-based coffee concept, it is farther from the firm’s core natural skincare range, so if results have not clearly met aspiration levels a narrow-range firm with limited slack would likely reallocate resources.

The cleansing foam is a close extension of an existing facial-care series and fits the firm’s established capabilities, so in a growing market management would be more likely to tolerate moderate uncertainty and keep it unless performance is clearly below aspirations.
